messages:
sam (release-manager): FYI - Incident in eu region affecting control-plane API. Hold any scheduled deploys for next 90m please. @oncall
deploy-bot: Rollout job r-2026-03-19-451 scheduled for 22:00 UTC has been PAUSED by sam. Reason: incident_hold
liyuan (oncall): Confirming - we're seeing 503s from control-plane during autoscale events in eu-west. Recommend holding until SRE verifies stability.
ben (eng-releases): Agreed, hold makes sense. Also propose we PIN the model-serving image for this rollout to r-infer-1.34.2 when we resume so nothing new slips in.
chris (sre): +1. Ops seeing spikes in api-proxy latency tied to control-plane backpressure. Suggest adding an automatic fallback to r-infer-1.34.1 if latency/regressions hit thresholds. Also will add a probe endpoint for canary checks: /health?probe=canary
ana (release-eng): I'll update the deploy manifest to include pinned_version=r-infer-1.34.2 and a graded rollout strategy. Preparing canary plan: 10 hosts canary -> 25% -> 100% over ~2h.
marta (product): Heads up - marketing email was queued for tomorrow morning. Hold that until we get a clear go/no-go.
ben (eng-releases): Decision summary: no immediate rollback of main; block auto-merges to main branch until we finish post-incident review. Tagging deploy job with incident-hold.
sara (qa): I'll run the full regression and the new latency scenario against r-infer-1.34.2 in staging. ETA ~90m.
liz (deploy-bot): Note: deploy lock set by sam. To resume use: `/deploy resume r-2026-03-19-451 --approved-by=sam`. Current lock: incident_hold.
sara (qa): Regression run finished: all unit/integration tests passed. Latency benchmark p95/p99 in staging within target; KV cache warm hit rate looks normal.
liyuan (oncall): Ops cleared at 01:45 UTC - network control-plane errors have dropped and autoscale behaved normally during spike window. Recommend resume at 02:00 UTC. @sam please confirm schedule.
sam (release-manager): Confirmed. Resume at 02:00 UTC. Monitoring plan: canary 30m, step to 25% 30m, then full. I'll watch latency, error-rate, and SLOs. :eyes:
deploy-bot: Resume initiated by sam at 1987693200. Canary started on 10 hosts (r-infer-1.34.2).
chris (sre): Alert thresholds set: if p50 > 120ms OR error_rate > 0.5% during canary we auto-rollback to r-infer-1.34.1. I've wired the circuit-breaker and alerted paging.
ana (release-eng): Release notes updated, marketing hold lifted contingent on 2 hours stable post-deploy.
ben (eng-releases): Closing coordination here for now. Keep incident tag on the rollout and add post-deploy validation checklist to the ticket. If anything flares up re-open thread. :thumbsup:
